item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Chicken curry, chicken simmered in a mild, velvety coconut curry sauce with pineapple, apples and onion, served on white rice and topped with parsley. Served with sweet mango chutney. The dish is gluten free and contains no allergens.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Old-fashioned Southern-style salmon cakes, served with lemon pepper roasted potatoes and steamed green beans. Served with tartar sauce, remoulade, lemon aioli and fresh cucumber and onion salad. Also available gluten free. (1+2+3+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Old-fashioned Southern-style pea protein cakes, served with lemon pepper roasted potatoes and steamed green beans. Served with tartar sauce, remoulade, lemon aioli and fresh cucumber and onion salad. Also available gluten free. (1+2+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Pan-fried chicken with fried courgette, served with chickpeas in warm yoghurt seasoned with saffron and warm spices. (6+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: patties with fried courgette, served with chickpeas in warm yoghurt seasoned with saffron and warm spices. (6+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Homemade Danish meatballs (frikadeller) with creamed peas and carrots, served with boiled potatoes and parsley. (1+2+6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Beetroot and quinoa patties with creamed peas and carrots, served with boiled potatoes and parsley. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Crispy chicken seasoned with orange and herbs, served with golden garlic-roasted potatoes and root vegetables, topped with parsley. Served with cranberry sauce with orange and chilli. The dish is gluten free. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Baked portobello seasoned with orange and herbs, served with golden garlic-roasted potatoes and root vegetables, topped with parsley. Served with cranberry sauce with orange and chilli. The dish is gluten free. (15)
